title: Canyon Oasis recording review: movement ownership and repeated Force Pull
review_method: Rendered video samples across the full two minutes, synchronized own-state traces and retained engine console events, followed by source tracing and normal-tick regressions.
stall_measure: Fresh alive observations remaining within 0.13 map units horizontally of a fixed anchor. Full-session times include warmup; these are not video timestamps. Jumping in place does not count as horizontal progress. The two reported episodes also show wall contact in the recording.

force_pull.observations: Two retained request bursts (five requests around session seconds 83-86 and ten around 124-131) targeted Jan holding the Bryar while her own active-power trace showed Absorb. Her weapon remained unchanged. With Absorb down around seconds 98-99, a subsequent request was followed by fists. The observations identify a tactical failure, not a causal attribution of every individual input.
changes: Validate recognized synchronized weapon model at request and release.
At release require range and the actual stock COG marker to identify the intended player; cancel through ordinary deselection when invalid.
After a validated release, wait 2 seconds before repeating Pull on the same opponent and unchanged weapon; further unchanged releases use 4, 8, 16 and at most 20 seconds.
A known weapon change, death or changed peer identity resets retry history. Unknown weapon models do not clear it.
Other opponents, gunfire and other eligible powers remain available. The bot does not read private remote Absorb state.

movement_changes: Advance underwater time on every living tick and treat the need for air as an urgent navigation objective.
After sustained lack of horizontal progress, route movement receives a bounded recovery interval during combat and hearing.
Attribute a failed route only after continuous ownership on the same node and goal; evaluate the expiry frame before returning control.
Preserve route heading and pitch for jump approach, committed flight and water exit while still checking physical aim for gunfire and servicing Force hold/cancellation.

covers: actual horizontal progress clears stall attribution
brief ownership does not blame an unused route
failed full recovery interval penalizes the driven route
off-axis opponent cannot steal ordinary/Force jump approach or flight heading
aligned gunfire and ordinary Force Jump hold remain available

private_stock_geometry_replay.method: Build navigation graph and run jkBot_Tick with stock swim/airborne physics and swept collision. Do not seed a navigation goal or exit phase.
private_stock_geometry_replay.limits: One shoreline, controlled starts facing the bank. Off-axis cases rotate the visible opponent 39.5 degrees from the required exit heading. This is not a live multiplayer qualification or coverage of every shoreline.

patched_source_regressions: portal geometry, water entry/exit and recessed pickup contact

live_comparison.claim: No live improvement is claimed by this receipt until a result is added.
